reviews.title: How are viral trends different from educational and commercial uses of LLM image generation and editing? A privacy-preserving descriptive analysis
reviews.organization: Google Behavioral Economics / Google Research / Google DeepMind / Google Marketing / Google Learning / Google Privacy, Security, & Safety / Google Gemini Data Science
reviews.source_review_scope: fixed byline, Urania method provenance, sample, privacy accounting and observational limits; not a full-article reading claim
reviews.reason: 确认 Google/DeepMind 实际作者。论文复用已有 Urania 的差分隐私聚类与聚合问答，描述 Nano Banana 真实使用，不是新的图像生成训练算法，也不是图像质量基准或线上 A/B。分析单位为对话，隐私预算 ε≤0.04、δ=0；以五大用途和 21 个特征聚合，不能从提示文本使用频率推断生成图像质量或因果产品提升。
reviews.production_evidence_kind: observational differentially-private usage analysis, not controlled A/B

cost_assessment.basis: 原文 §3 的非公开生产对话样本与完整 DP 聚合配置；未进行本地成本测量
cost_assessment.scale: 2026 Q1 90 天中抽样约 2.1M 对话、超过 5.2M 提示；五类共 831 个保留簇、21 个聚合特征，底层个体提示/图像不可供本地完整再分析。
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac; no private data access or experiment was attempted
cost_assessment.cost_type: 百万级非公开生产交互与受隐私会计约束的聚合分析；不能用公开小样本伪复现整体分布
